name: Hasta: TEST hastasi ekleme, TC 11 hane, listede gorunme
description: TEST hesabi ile giris yapilir. Yalnizca adi TEST ile baslayan kayitlar olusturulur.

planSteps.description: Log in on /login with the TEST account credentials configured for this project (clinic e-mail, username and password)
Open the Patients page (/patients) and start creating a new patient
Fill the patient form: first name 'TEST Senaryo', last name 'HASTA', a valid phone number, and the T.C. identity number 12345678901 (any random 11 digits)
Verify no error about an invalid T.C. identity number is shown and the patient was created
Verify the patient 'TEST Senaryo HASTA' appears in the patient list and has a protocol number
Create another patient named 'TEST Kisa Tc HASTA' with a T.C. identity number that has only 10 digits
Verify the form rejects the 10-digit T.C. number with a message saying it must be 11 digits
